guides.name: Cleric 1v1 PvP — Th3Ruthless

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: The duel chapter of Th3Ruthless's Cleric guide: Earth Punishment makes Condemnation crit and reset, Noble Aura adds steady damage, Light of Protection adds tolerance and Salvation is the emergency button. Build pressure with Mark, Chain and Earth Punishment, keep attacking through the opponent's defensives and heal only in safe windows. Against heavy healers or shields, Voice of Doom replaces Noble Aura.

rotation: Before the duel: Light of Protection up, Noble Aura ready, Light of Regeneration running, room to move.
Open pressure with Debilitating Mark, Chain of Torment and Earth Punishment, then keep attacking through the window.
Chain Condemnation while Earth Punishment is on the target; weave Earth's Retribution and Judgment Thunder into the gaps.
Commit Divine Aura and Bolt only when the opponent cannot soak them with a defensive.
Heal early in safe moments; hold Defiance for real control and Salvation for a lethal focus window.

tips.title: Leveling priority
tips.text: Take Condemnation, Divine Aura, Healing Light, Radiant Recovery and Defiance to 20 first; Earth's Retribution and Bolt follow as resources allow. At skill level 16 the article runs Condemnation 4/5, Divine Aura 3/5, Healing Light 1/3 and Defiance 4/5.

tips.title: Against melee
tips.text: Condemnation 3/4/5 trades some single-target damage for a root chance, and Judgment Thunder 2/3/5 trades its root for a Combat Speed debuff. Root and stun procs are chance-based, so do not plan Bolt around them.

tips.title: Common mistakes
tips.text: Casting Bolt into a defensive cooldown, walking out of Divine Aura, healing minor damage instead of attacking, and using defensives too late.

tips.title: Voice of Doom swap
tips.text: Replace Noble Aura with Voice of Doom against heavy healing or shields: from Lv. 10 it strips shields, at 20 it cuts healing and potions by 60%. Use it only when you can follow up with damage.

tips.title: Stats
tips.text: Get enough Accuracy to land key hits, then PvP Damage Boost, Combat Speed and Cooldown Reduction; on defense HP, PvP Damage Tolerance, Critical Hit Resist and Status Effect Resist. Do not stack Critical Hit: Condemnation already crits under Earth Punishment.

tips.title: Passives
tips.text: After the key actives: Survival Willpower, Warm Benediction, Earth's Grace, Empyrean Lord's Grace, Immortal Veil, Healing Enhancement. The first four aim for 20 with bonuses; Heal Block can wait.

tips.title: Salvation
tips.text: Keep Salvation as the default emergency tool while you learn how much burst you can survive. It does not trigger by itself.

$join: An endgame support build: Healing Light, Light of Regeneration and Radiant Recovery keep the team up, while Chain of Torment and Condemnation (made to crit by Earth Punishment) add damage between heals. Yustiel's Power and Root are fixed stigmas, Light of Protection is a flex slot for Absolution or Benevolence. Damage skills sit on one macro key, heals are pressed by hand.

rotation: Open with Bolt, Divine Aura, Debilitating Mark and Judgment Thunder, then hold the E macro: Chain of Torment, Earth Punishment, Condemnation.
Earth Punishment makes Condemnation crit, and the crit resets its cooldown.
Only damage skills go on the macro; heals are cast by hand to manage their cooldowns.
Keep Light of Regeneration up; Radiant Recovery after burst or a key status, Healing Light on cooldown and as backup for the lowest ally.

tips.title: Macro setup
tips.text: Group the macro'd damage skills on one key and set the macro display delay to roughly half your ping; every other skill is pressed manually.

tips.title: Flex stigma
tips.text: Light of Protection is the flexible slot: swap it for Absolution or Benevolence. It is redundant if a Chanter with Undefeated Mantra is in the party.

tips.title: Fixed stigmas
tips.text: Yustiel's Power is treated as essential for party survival; Root locks targets down and helps you keep distance.

tips.title: Daevanion
tips.text: Fill the +1 nodes of Chain of Torment, Condemnation and Judgment Thunder before orange stat nodes. Per board: Nezekan — Combat Speed, Cooldown Reduction; Zikel — Damage Boost; Vaizel — Critical Damage Boost; Triniel — Multi-hit Chance; Azphel — PvP Damage Boost, then PvP Damage Tolerance and Status Effect Chance.

tips.title: Arcana and god stats
tips.text: Magic Armor set (Chalice, Parchment, Compass and Bell of Magic plus a Mirror of Vigor) with Light of Regeneration, Healing Light and Healing Enhancement as sub-skills. God stat order: Time, Justice, Life, Destiny, Illusion.

tips.title: Manastones
tips.text: The author's gear uses PvP Attack, PvP Accuracy, PvP Block and HP stones, with Defense on the helmet and pauldrons. Main stats are HP, MP/Defense and Combat Speed.

$join: A group build for Abyss skirmishes and frontline team fights: stay free of control, cleanse quickly and keep panic buttons for the team. It runs Light of Protection, Absolution, Yustiel's Power and Salvation, and swaps several PvE specializations for root, stun, slow and cleanse options. Survival stats come before damage.

rotation: Keep Defiance for hard control instead of using it on a timer.
Peel for the team: Debilitating Mark on the enemy caller, then Chain of Torment to focus them.
Radiant Recovery for the double cleanse and team healing; Healing Light adds a chance to remove a debuff.

tips.title: Specialization timing
tips.text: Slots open at skill levels 8, 12 and 20; until level 20, equip the first two listed options.

tips.title: PvP swaps
tips.text: Compared with PvE, Condemnation takes the root chance, Bolt the full-charge stun, Divine Aura the slow, Healing Light the debuff removal and Light of Regeneration the Move Speed boost instead of damage or healing bonuses. Earth's Retribution and Radiant Recovery stay as in PvE.

tips.title: With a Chanter
tips.text: Light of Protection does not stack with a Chanter's Undefeated Mantra, so take Benevolence in that slot.

tips.title: Salvation levels
tips.text: At Lv. 15 the immunity bubble also covers the lowest-HP party member; at Lv. 20 you can cast it while stunned or knocked down.
